description: This Java interface defines a contract for consuming message responses, encapsulating the expected response type and a BiConsumer to handle successful or erroneous responses. It is annotated as deprecated and is part of the message handling subsystem within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MessageResponseConsumer
classes.description: An interface for consuming message responses, indicating the type of response and providing a BiConsumer for notification.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the expected response type.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Provides the BiConsumer that handles the message or error response.
